description:
The user's CapitalSnitch watchlist (Edge plan, up to 25 tickers). Watchlist companies get INSTANT EMAIL ALERTS
(insider buys, big insider sales, new stock offerings; ~30 minutes after the SEC filing) and lead the daily email
briefing. Use for 'alert me when insiders buy NVDA', 'add PLTR and SOFI to my watchlist', 'what am I watching?',
'stop alerting me about TSLA'. Never counts toward the daily limit.

action.description: list = show it; add/remove tickers; replace = set the whole list.
